generic_domain.justification: Language Model Attacking & Defending is a broad domain that encompasses techniques aimed at improving the robustness and security of language models. It covers various subdomains such as detoxification, which refers to removing harmful or toxic content from model outputs. Detoxification can be seen as part of attacking (detecting toxic content) and defending mechanisms (mitigating or preventing it). Therefore, choosing this domain allows for the inclusion of all specific techniques like language model detoxification.
